description: The account of one ACME CA (the EAB values are never returned)

email.description: The contact email, empty when none or not recorded

eab_kid_set.description: Whether an EAB key ID is stored; the value is never returned

eab_hmac_key_set.description: Whether an EAB HMAC key is stored; the value is never returned

state.description: registered: the CA has the account; pending: it could not be reached yet; failed: the CA or certbot refused it

error.description: The CA's or certbot's last message, null when there is none

registered_on.description: When the account was registered, null before
